Migration 0069 (number taken under the migration slot, D10-116) lets app.notify_logs record a push the user switched off: status gains 'suppressed', a nullable suppress_reason column accepts only 'push_disabled', and one CHECK ties them (status = suppressed iff suppress_reason is set) and keeps sent_at null on suppressed rows. Two frozen DB tests list notify_logs columns exactly (B1-12e send-log [AC-B1-12e#2], B1-12f template-override [AC-B1-12f#11]); orchestrator mechanical test(spec) commits add only the suppress_reason entry to each list (ledger test_paths; class 1, label checked by the orchestrator under approvals #24); no assertion is removed or weakened. No money, no attribution.
